top_signals.title: Oil Jumps After Trump Says US Doesn’t Need Deal With Iran
top_signals.summary: Oil rose, erasing earlier losses, after President Donald Trump said that the US doesn’t need a deal with Iran, leaving the conflict that has roiled Middle East supplies unresolved.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Uber’s UK banking partner Griffin raises $20M for stablecoin services
top_signals.summary: The Series B valued Griffin at more than $100 million and will help fund stablecoin reserve services and onchain cross-border payments.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Ethlabs proposes advancing Ethereum’s post-quantum to 2027, citing AI acceleration
top_signals.summary: The group said it aims to make Ethereum post-AI by 2027 as well, resistant to cryptographic risks that AI development is bringing.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Turkey Agrees to Record $1.6 Billion Climate Policy Funding Deal
top_signals.summary: Turkey and the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) on Thursday agreed on a $1.6-billion climate financing package to support Turkey’s climate goals in the biggest climate-focused deal of the Asian bank to date.  The deal was announced in Antalya, where Turkey is hosting the COP31 global climate summit until November 20.    Under the agreement, AIIB founding member Turkey will access a Climate-Focused Policy-Based Financing (CPBF) loan for the Türkiye Climate Action Acceleration Program (TCAAP) with supplemental…
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Indonesian vice president, son of former leader, steps down over diploma scandal
top_signals.summary: The son of former President Joko Widodo had filed a certificate saying his overseas education was equivalent to a vocational high school in Indonesia.
